_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: 0 of 64 windows moved ±2+ points in 12h over 7 days — this is a textbook coil where forced directional guesses go 0-for-18, so HOLD with conviction is the skilled call until the breaker arrives.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst calls HOLD with medium conviction citing the coil and misleading analog; narrative implies an imminent bullish turn with 0.75 confidence, creating a direct split on direction
next_move.confirmed_if: ETF flows spike above 40 with fear_greed below 35 and BTC momentum cooling below 50 — genuine accumulation into fear validating a Disbelief leg up
next_move.invalidated_if: Fear_greed drops below 20 with VIX above 70 and funding negative — true panic/Capitulation killing the Anxiety hold and forcing a Depression leg down
